prompt: A dramatic medieval battle scene. A knight in full plate armor is on a white horse, facing a large, red dragon. A tall castle tower stands behind the dragon, and the tower is taller than the dragon is long. The dragon is much larger than the knight and horse combined. The knight is pointing a lance at the dragon's chest; the lance is longer than the knight's shield. The horse is rearing up, with its front hooves in the air. The dragon is opening its mouth, breathing fire towards the knight. The castle tower has an unfurled flag on its top, waving above four archers on the tower wall. The knight is holding a shield on his left arm, blocking some of the fire. A catapult is positioned between the knight and the castle tower, and it is launching a large rock at the dragon. The number of soldiers operating the catapult is half the number of archers on the tower wall. The dragon is breaking the ground with its claw. The horse has a saddle on its back. The shield has a crest painted on its front.
